name: freecad-agentlink
description: Drive FreeCAD from Claude: parts, printability, strength, drawings, scans (ScanRuler for FreeCAD), and pictures of the work — headless, or in the FreeCAD window when its link is on.
long_description: Finds FreeCAD on this Mac and installs the Agent Link and ScanRuler for FreeCAD add-ons into its Mod folder. Works headless with no FreeCAD window open. To watch the work, open FreeCAD, pick the Agent Link workbench and press Start link, then start a new chat: the extension relays to the window. Agent Link is LGPL-2.1-or-later; ScanRuler for FreeCAD is AGPL-3.0-only, ported from ScanRuler by CNC Kitchen (Stefan Hermann).

out_dir.title: Output folder
out_dir.description: Where exports, drawings and pictures go.
